sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 125

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 125:1
items.html: At the time of the second restriction, when the concluding Malchut ascended to the place of the Bina of the body of the Partzuf TNHY of AA, which is the Chazeh [chest], then the posterior vessels of this Partzuf descended to the empty void, for the vessels from the Chazeh and downward, which are called the posterior vessels, are already found below the concluding Malchut. (Item 3).
